csv_scope_of_work: The City of Newton May be seeking a Planning/Design for With the completion of the streetscape master planning effort, a phased approach to implementation for downtown improvements can be initiated. The first step in the process is to complete the engineering, detailed design work for the downtown streetscape. Engineering work is targeted to begin in 2022, with phased construction following. Phase I is proposed to cover the area immediately around the courthouse square. This area includes the North Square Plaza, which is a higher level of treatment of 100 block of North 2nd Avenue W to allow for a more pedestrian feel when the street is closed for community events. A portion of this whole project was included in a request for funding to the Maytag Family Foundation.
